name: Jose
source:
A callous and cold prisoner at the same jail as [url=/c10893]Guys[/url]. Like Guys, Jose is a juvenile delinquent. However, Jose is far more malicious and aggressive than Guys. He was imprisoned for raping a woman when he was drinking. 

[Based on the [URL=http://www.langmaor.com/l01/l0102.htm]official website's character profiles[/URL].]
